title: Eleven Minutes Past Six
subtitle: 事故与安全 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 事故与安全（灾害防范·事故与安全）
meta: 主题语境：事故与安全（灾害防范·事故与安全）　|　核心词汇：accident　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 accident 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① accident happened at eleven minutes past six on a Tuesday in 1974; it took eleven seconds, it was over, and my father walked home from it, which is the part nobody has ever believed. He found the letter ② by accident eleven years later, in a drawer, and said nothing, and I have never decided whether that was kindness.

There had been a ③ road accident at the same corner in 1961, and another in 1968, and the accident was the third, and the council had measured the corner eleven times and done nothing, and my grandmother said measuring is what you do instead of acting.

It was not ④ accident that the third one was the one they acted on, and my grandmother said the reason was that the third one was a child, that this is how the world is arranged, and that she had stopped being surprised by it in 1931, and no accident, she said, is ever the last.

Being born in that house was an ⑤ accident of birth, and my mother said the phrase had been invented for her family and that eleven of them had proved it. It was ⑥ no accident that the gate went up in 1974 and not 1973, and my grandmother said the difference was one letter, written by one woman, and she would not say more.

The ⑦ accident of the muffins in 1981, by which she meant the batch nobody planned and everybody liked, was the only happy one in the family, and they made them for eleven years and never got them right again. The ⑧ accident, meaning the thing that arrives without asking, came for my father in 1989, in his own kitchen, at sixty-one, and there was no corner, no council and nothing to measure. The ⑨ accident I think about most is not his but the one in 1968, because the man in it was my uncle and nobody has ever said his name. The ⑩ accident, meaning the ordinary word, decided more of my family's life than any decision anybody in it ever made.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 事故；意外事件
B. n. 偶然；碰巧（的事）
C. n. 意外的好事；歪打正着
E. 固定搭配：by accident 偶然地；意外地
F. 固定搭配：a road / car accident 道路交通事故／车祸
G. 固定搭配：an accident of birth 出生的偶然；出身
H. 固定搭配：it is / was no accident that ... ……绝非偶然

items.q: The accident happened at eleven minutes
He found the letter by accident
There had been a road accident
It was not accident that the third
an accident of birth, and my mother
It was no accident that the gate
The accident of the muffins in 1981
The accident, meaning the thing that arrives
The accident I think about most
The accident, meaning the ordinary word

answers.why: the accident 意为“事故”，事故发生在 1974 年一个周二六点十一分，只用了十一秒。
by accident 意为“偶然地、意外地”，十一年后他在一个抽屉里偶然发现了那封信。
a road accident 意为“道路交通事故”，1961 年同一个路口发生过一起交通事故，1968 年又一起。
accident 意为“偶然、碰巧”，他们偏偏对第三起作出反应，这并非偶然。
an accident of birth 意为“出生的偶然、出身”，生在那栋房子里纯属出生的偶然。
it was no accident that ... 意为“……绝非偶然”，1974 年而不是 1973 年装上那道门绝非偶然。
the accident of the muffins 意为“一次歪打正着、意外的好事”，指 1981 年谁也没计划、却人人喜欢的那炉玛芬。
the accident 意为“不测、横祸”，1989 年那场不测找上我父亲时，是在他自家厨房里。
the accident 意为“事故”，我想得最多的事故不是他的，而是 1968 年那一起。
the accident 意为“意外、事故（这个普通的词）”，这个词决定了我家人的生活，比家里任何人作出的任何决定都多。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 事故发生在 1974 年一个周二六点十一分，只用了十一秒就结束了。（accident）
十一年后他在一个抽屉里偶然发现了那封信，什么也没说。（by accident）
1961 年同一个路口发生过一起交通事故，1968 年又一起，议会测量了十一次。（road accident）
他们偏偏对第三起作出反应，这并非偶然。（accident）
生在那栋房子里纯属出身的偶然，我母亲说这话就是为她们家造的。（an accident of birth）
1974 年而不是 1973 年装上那道门绝非偶然。（it was no accident that）
answers: The accident happened at eleven minutes past six on a Tuesday in 1974 and took eleven seconds.
He found the letter by accident eleven years later, in a drawer, and said nothing.
There had been a road accident at the same corner in 1961, and another in 1968, and the council measured the corner eleven times.
It was not accident that the third one was the one they acted on.
Being born in that house was an accident of birth, and my mother said the phrase was invented for her family.
It was no accident that the gate went up in 1974 and not 1973.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 accident 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The accident happened at eleven minutes past six on a Tuesday in 1974, and he found the letter by accident eleven years later.
There had been a road accident at the same corner in 1961, and another in 1968, and the council had measured the corner eleven times.
It was not accident that they acted on the third one, and being born in that house was an accident of birth.
It was no accident that the gate went up in 1974 and not 1973.
The accident of the muffins in 1981 was the only happy one in the family.
